item.title: Artwork di Eduardo netkingZ Bartali: NKZ Retopia
item.description:
🎨 Dalla community Shortcut: NKZ Retopia
Artwork di Eduardo netkingZ Bartali 👏
“Draw the flow. Keep the control. ✏️🟦 NKZ Retopia is out — my retopology add-on for Blender. ▸ Sketch regions in any order → ordered quad grids ▸ Rigid strips of square quads, Precise Draw with snapping ▸ Contours around limbs, Circle Loops for eyes & mouths ▸ Relax with even quads — no folded faces, ever ▸ Smart symmetry that finds the real centre…”
